title: Reader Journey V2 节奏适配配置加载与派生可靠性修复

commits.message: Add V2 config reliability tests and deterministic re-finalize repair tool.
Fix V2 role-target config loading and pacing_fit fail-safe derivation.
Register CHG-20260727-013 for V2 pacing_fit config loading fix.
Record CHG-20260727-013 implementation and test evidence.
Mark CHG-20260727-013 implemented and tested with evidence.
Attach final CHG-20260727-013 commit in registry.

user_summary: 修复安装态未加载 scene_role_targets 导致 pacing_fit 全部变为90、界面全显示合适的问题
technical_summary: 安装态未打包/未以 resource_root 加载 scene_role_targets.json，loader 静默空表后 compute_pacing_fit 回退 [0,100]，导致 pacing_fit 全为 90。本 Change 修复资源定位、校验、失败可见性，并提供 deterministic re-finalize。
acceptance_criteria: 开发/测试/安装态均以 cwd 无关方式加载 scene_role_targets 与 formulas_v2
配置缺失或非法时不得产生虚假 pacing_fit=90
PyInstaller 产物包含所需 V2 配置文件
显式 run 的 deterministic re-finalize dry-run/apply 可修复存量错误 fit
不修改正式 AppData；不调用真实 Provider
tests: isolated dry-run/apply re-finalize on AppData copy run_id=1
verification_evidence: resource_root loading; no [0,100] fallback; isolated re-finalize fits 40/90/90/50/80/90/40/80/50
56 passed V2 local/config/packaging/pipeline tests; isolated dry-run+apply idempotent; formal AppData untouched

data_compatibility.notes: 派生字段 pacing_fit 可为 null（unavailable）；旧客户端在无 fit 时回退本地 band 标签。不自动改写用户库；需显式 repair apply。
